purpose: Teach: 責める/信憑/引き合い/駆け引き/特筆/計る/かねる/直近

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 部下を、本気で、絶対、責めるばかりでは、絶対、ダメよね、本気で、絶対、励まそうね
lines.en: We can't just blame our team members—we need to encourage them seriously.
lines.style: Clear, direct instruction. Warm but firm resolve. Opens with conviction. The tone of someone who's thought about this and means it. Not stern—principled.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。データの信憑性、本気で、絶対、徹底的に、絶対、確認しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're checking the data credibility thoroughly. I appreciate your trust.
lines.style: Earnest and steady. A small nod of agreement in the voice. Professional but genuine. Not rushed—each word carries weight. The assurance of someone doing the work right.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お客様の引き合い、本気で、絶対、増えてきていますね、本気で、絶対、嬉しい
lines.en: Customer inquiries are increasing, which is really encouraging.
lines.style: Lift of genuine pleasure on 「増えてきていますね」. Warmer than before—this is good news. Not forced cheer, but the real satisfaction of seeing momentum. Slightly brighter pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商談、本気で、絶対、駆け引きの場面、絶対、ありますが、絶対、誠実に、進めてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. There are moments in negotiations that require strategy, but we'll handle them honestly.
lines.style: Balanced acknowledgment—not naive, not cynical. Steady resolve underneath. A slight pause before 「誠実に」, like underlining it. Professional confidence without arrogance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今月の業績、本気で、絶対、特筆すべき、絶対、内容ね、本気で、絶対、社員、皆、絶対、頑張ってくれて、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: This month's results are really impressive. Everyone on the team stepped up, and I'm genuinely grateful for that.
lines.style: Warm and expansive. Real pride here—not performative. Opens with appreciation, lands on gratitude. Slower pace on 「皆頑張ってくれて」, savoring the team effort. The voice of a leader who notices.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の満足度、本気で、絶対、計る活動、続けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're continuing to measure customer satisfaction. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Composed, steady report. Professional without being stiff. A small weight of commitment on the work itself. The tone of someone following through on what they said they'd do.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 急な要請、本気で、絶対、お断りしかねる、絶対、状況、絶対、慎重に、対応しましょう
lines.en: With sudden requests like this, we need to be cautious about how we respond.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. A slight slowdown on 「慎重に」—this is the careful part. Not hesitant, but deliberate. The voice of someone protecting both the team and the relationship.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。直近のアンケート、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対、ご好評、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The recent customer feedback has been very positive. I'm thankful for that.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Closing note—not rushed, but complete. A small nod of acknowledgment in the pacing. Professional, warm, genuine. The final confirmation of good work.
